snippet.title: Percepts Magnavox Odyssey 1972
snippet.description:
Percepts is a racing video game released in 1972 for Magnavox Odyssey in which the overlay has squares containing patterns and symbols on them; players race to the correct square when the corresponding card is drawn from a deck. It uses the game card 2, an overlay, 15 green cards and 15 purple cards with symbols and patterns.

The GREEN Card Deck should be arranged face up in three horizontal rows of 5 cards each. Both players study the position of the PATTERN or SYMBOL arrangement on the cards in the three rows.

The PURPLE Card Deck must be placed between the players face down. One by one is selected to reveal the pattern or symbol the players must reach.

In the game of PATTERNS, you will race across the Game Overlay to be the first to arrive at the position on the overlay that duplicates the position of the PATTERN selected on each turn. The PATTERN winner is the player that collects the most GREEN PERCEPTS Cards.

In the game of SYMBOLS, you must memorize the location of the 15 different
SYMBOLS in order to beat your opponent by collecting the most PERCEPTS Cards.  


Source: https://archive.org/details/OdySim/page/40/mode/2up

Gameplay: OdySim Simulator 1080p 60 FPS
